description: A Frappe framework report script for calculating campaign efficiency metrics, including lead counts, opportunity counts, quotation counts, order counts, and related percentages, based on campaign data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the report columns structure based on a given field.

methods.name: get_lead_data
methods.description: Fetches lead-related data and computes campaign metrics.

methods.name: get_filter_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on date filters.

methods.name: get_quotation_ordered_count
methods.description: Counts quotations with 'Ordered' status for leads.

methods.name: get_order_amount
methods.description: Calculates total order amount for leads.
